title: Object of will; proofs God wills
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): by means belonging toward that same which His essence stands as excellently borne toward ye good known by means belonging toward Himself — the will belonging toward God stands as His highest perfection. out from perfection belonging toward essence, out from intellect, out from spiritual life, out from inward plus outward operations, out from ye consent belonging toward ye church plus belonging toward ye philosophers — that God truly wills we prove out from ye testimonies belonging toward Scripture. For will stands as borne toward a known good. The object stands as ye good known by means belonging toward ye intellect. III.
pass_b_english: III. The object is the good known by the intellect. For will is borne toward a known good. That God truly wills we prove from the testimonies of Scripture, from perfection of essence, from intellect, from spiritual life, from inward and outward operations, from the consent of the church and of the philosophers.
The will of God is His highest perfection, by which His essence is excellently borne toward the good known by Himself.
source_text: III. Objectum est bonum ab intellectu cognitum. Voluntas enim fertur in bonum cognitum. Deum vero velle ita probamus a Scripturae testimoniis, ab essentiae perfectione, ab intellectu, a spirituali vita, ab operationibus internis et externis, a consensu ecclesiae et philosophorum. Voluntas Dei est summa illius perfectio, qua essentia ipsius excellenter fertur in bonum a se cognitum.
